description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for managing TextTrack features such as Closed Captions styles, TTML styles, capabilities, and session handling within the WPEFramework. It includes interface definitions for setting styles, handling notifications, querying capabilities, and controlling text track sessions.

classes.name: ITextTrackClosedCaptionsStyle
classes.description: Interface for managing Closed Captions styles, including setting styles, registering notifications, and handling style change events.

classes.name: ITextTrackTtmlStyle
classes.description: Interface for managing global TTML style overrides, including setting and retrieving style strings, and notifications.

classes.name: ITextTrackCapabilities
classes.description: Interface for querying TextTrack capabilities supported by the implementation.

classes.name: ITextTrack
classes.description: Interface for handling TextTrack sessions, including opening, closing, resetting sessions, sending data, and controlling modes.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for style changes.

methods.name: SetFontFamily
methods.description: Sets the font family for captions.

methods.name: GetFontFamily
methods.description: Gets the current font family setting.

methods.name: SetFontSize
methods.description: Sets the font size for captions.

methods.name: GetFontSize
methods.description: Gets the current font size setting.

methods.name: GetCapability
methods.description: Queries support for a specific TextTrack capability.

methods.name: ApplyCustomClosedCaptionsStyleToSession
methods.description: Applies custom style to a session.

methods.name: SetPreviewText
methods.description: Sets preview text in a session.

methods.name: SetSessionClosedCaptionsService
methods.description: Sets CC service for a session.

methods.name: SetSessionTeletextSelection
methods.description: Sets Teletext page for a session.

methods.name: ApplyCustomTtmlStyleOverridesToSession
methods.description: Overrides TTML styles for a session.

methods.name: AssociateVideoDecoder
methods.description: Associates a video decoder handle with a session.

methods.name: GetInterfaceVersion
methods.description: Returns the interface version supported by the implementation.
